_schema: Market and product parameters for the <st>-<metro> pack (preservation-loan-book). Every value carries value, as_of and source. Mark anything not pulled this quarter verify: true. Statutory day/month counts live ONLY here (plb/agency_calendar.py reads them); fill them from the state's preservation-notice law (federal/preservation-notice-laws-by-state.md) and the federal rules, and mark each verify until the statute text is read. No market-rate cap rates, price per unit, refinance spreads or buyer-side fees belong in this pack.

cap_rate_affordable.source: derived: Class C cap + 100 bp for as-restricted collateral context inside recap memos only

ust10.source: PLACEHOLDER 10-year US Treasury (FRED DGS10); pull before any run

senior_rate_default.source: PLACEHOLDER ust10 + spread for recap gap framing; replace with the senior lender's quote

push_window_prep_months.source: <INTERNAL prep lead time before the owner-notice period opens; not a statutory figure unless your state sets one>; PUSH_WINDOW_PREP

push_first_notice_months.source: <state law: owner first notice to agency / local government at least N months before withdrawal>; PUSH_FIRST_NOTICE_DUE

push_second_notice_months.source: <state law: second notice, if any>; PUSH_SECOND_NOTICE_DUE (null disables)

tenant_notice_months.source: <state law: tenant notice window [max, min] months>; TENANT_NOTICE_WINDOW

sb973_operative_restriction_date.source: <state law operative date for restrictions, if phased in>; anchors before it get tenant_notice_status n/a_pre_operative

records_request_after_notice_days.source: internal target for RECORDS_REQUEST_DUE after the owner's notice

records_request_response_days.source: <state law: owner records response period>; RECORDS_RESPONSE_DUE

rofr_match_days.source: <state law: matching-offer period from the owner's mailing of a third-party offer>; ROFR_MATCH_DEADLINE

rofr_duration_months_after_termination.source: <state law: purchase-right duration after the withdrawal date (Oregon: 24 months, ORS 456.262)>

rofr_recordable_days_after_offer.source: <state law: waiting period between the qualified purchaser's offer and recording its notice of purchase right (Oregon: 30 days, ORS 456.262)>; ROFR_RECORDABLE_DATE

push_program_coverage_verified.source: <set true once the state rule's covered-program list has been read; false flags HOME-only / LIHTC-only rows with Verify — PuSH Coverage>

hap_optout_package_days.source: HUD Section 8 Renewal Policy Guidebook ch. 11 (verify); HAP_OPTOUT_PACKAGE_DUE

hap_annual_renewal_roll_months.source: convention: next_expected_expiration for stale annual contracts

av_is_market.source: <assessment regime>; this pack carries no value on a lead

recorder_image_fee.source: <county recorder fee schedule> (LURA / ROFR images on documents_to_request.csv)

safmr.source: HUD SAFMR by ZIP and bedroom; optional NOAH watch and restricted NOI floor
